**Finding submitted: deviation (§ 2.1, p0012).**

- **Issue:** § 2.1 binds us to a USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay minimum for three years, "without reduction or termination rights" — the playbook walk-away position.
- **Internal conflicts:** § 9.4 gives us termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with fees only for conforming Services rendered, and § 12.3 has Vendor acknowledge we made no minimum-volume commitment.
- **Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** replaced the commitment with "Customer will pay only for Services used or ordered during the applicable term. Customer has no minimum purchase, take-or-pay, or shortfall obligation.", matching seed precedent; fallback (12-month reducible commitment with true-up) flagged in the comment.
